title: Vertiv Holdings Co. (VRT): AI Thermal & Power Compounder Under Stage 4 Multiple Compression
archetype: AI Data Center Power & Liquid Cooling Compounder
primer: Vertiv Holdings Co. (NYSE: VRT) leads in mission-critical data center power and liquid cooling, generating 23.9% TTM ROIC and 25.2% Q3 2026 adjusted operating margins. Management raised FY2026 sales guidance to ~$14.7B on >100% organic order growth. Yet the stock has fallen 46.8% from its 52-week high into a Stage 4 downtrend at $202.07 (20.4x forward P/E). New capital waits for $190.88–$196.70 support or a $224.06+ reclaim (5.05:1 asymmetry to $255 base), while the 23-share Schwab holding stays on a strict $185.16 hard stop.
holding_rationale: Schwab holds 23.0 shares at a $6,058.58 cost basis and $4,647.61 market value. That position sits at -$1,410.97 (-23.29%), or 5.24% of $88,684.68 net worth. VRT is a COMPOUNDER_PASS business trading at 20.4x forward P/E, just 4.1% above major Pivot S1 support ($193.79). Panic-selling at $202.07 risks selling into exhaustion, so hold with a strict $185.16 hard stop.

holding_alerts.instruction: EXIT_IMMEDIATELY: sell all 23 Schwab shares to prevent a Stage 4 cascade toward Pivot S2 ($155.09).

holding_alerts.trigger: Relief bounce stalls at 50-day SMA ($231.31) on below-average volume
holding_alerts.instruction: TRIM_INTO_STRENGTH: trim 8 shares (~35% of position) into Stage 4 overhead supply to cut beta risk.

holding_alerts.trigger: Weekly close above $231.31 on >1.5x 30-day average volume
holding_alerts.instruction: HOLD / STAGE 2 RECLAIM: keep all 23 shares and trail stop upward behind the rising 10-week EMA.

redeployment_plan.capital_source: Next marginal cash unit ($1,000+) or proceeds if the 23-share Schwab VRT position ($4,647.61) triggers its $185.16 hard stop.

destinations.recommendation: Retain 60% in USD Cash / Treasury Bills
destinations.rationale: US market regime is in Correction (below 50-DMA, 6 distribution days) and VRT is in Stage 4; cash preserves optionality until VRT builds a Stage 1/2 floor.
destinations.entry_condition: Deploy into VRT only on confirmed stabilization in $190.88–$196.70 or weekly reclaim above $224.06.

destinations.recommendation: Allocate 40% to Stage 2 shortlist leader MSFT
destinations.rationale: MSFT ($523.88 close) is in a confirmed Stage 2 uptrend inside its $507.61–$526.78 buy zone with a $452.41 stop and $660.00 base target (1.79:1 asymmetry from zone high).
destinations.entry_condition: BUY_AT_CMP_NO_FOMO inside $507.61–$526.78 with invalidation stop at $452.41.

destinations.recommendation: Watchlist peer ETN at 0% allocation today
destinations.rationale: Eaton (Boyd Thermal acquirer) offers electrical/thermal exposure at 21.67x forward P/E, but 0% is allocated while the broader US market remains in Correction.
destinations.entry_condition: Revisit only after US market breadth >50-DMA recovers above 60% and ETN confirms a Stage 2 breakout.
